analysis: The changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md. The visible base units cover lines 1-797, but the changed ranges are at base lines 1087-1088 and head lines 1087-1090, 1100-1146 and 2028-2041, which lie outside those units. The patch excerpt is truncated. It shows only a documentation table edit that moves the CBv2 scheduler prefill geometry from 512/2048 to 2048/4096 for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and Gemma 4. It also changes solo-stripe defaults and adds a bidirectional media prefill chunk ceiling of 512. These are documentation statements and do not change any security control in this PR. The corresponding code changes, in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift and CBv2Contracts.swift, are not supplied. Where they matter, the effect would be availability and memory pressure (T-029, TB-007) and activation-memory admission. The wider prefill chunk may alter per-step transient memory and GPU monopolisation, but the supplied evidence cannot show whether admission and reserve accounting were updated. Nothing here touches the prefix-cache (T-041) controls, attestation, authorization or encryption. The surrounding unchanged Nemotron and GLM text that I read is pre-existing. I found no concrete regression. Open question for integration: if the code behind these doc changes is in the PR, confirm that the larger prefill chunk and step budget are covered by activation-reserve and admission accounting, and that the 512 media ceiling is enforced.
